title: Watching the 15th Regiment band march up Fifth Avenue
summary: Soldiers return from World War I and Scott follows the 15th Regiment band to Harlem, inspired.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: But, anyhow, I played in both bands. Well, I learned a lot from that. I mean, I played in both bands at the games that they played, and at the assemblies when the students were there. Well, one thing led to another. I was getting experience a lot, and I wanted it so badly. The fellows came from World War I, the soldiers came back. The colored regiment was

the 15th Regiment. And when they came, they marched on up Fifth Avenue on up to Harlem. I was down there to meet them. And (unintelligible) had the 15th band, don't you know, I walked all the way with that band on the sidewalk, all the way up to Harlem, and just listened to it. I was so inspired with it.
